definitions.explanation: An indefinite but small number of days, typically implying around two to five or six days. A slightly formal alternative to {何日|なんにち}か.

examples.japanese: {数日|すうじつ}{後|ご}に{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: It will arrive in a few days.

examples.japanese: {数日|すうじつ}{前|まえ}から{体調|たいちょう}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: I have been feeling unwell since a few days ago.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}で{数日|すうじつ}{家|いえ}を{空|あ}けるので、{猫|ねこ}の{世話|せわ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: Since I'll be away from home for several days on a business trip, I asked someone to look after my cat.

notes:
A common word meaning "several days." Composed of {数|すう} (several/a few) + {日|じつ} (days). The prefix {数|すう} can combine with many counters to mean "several" of that unit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数日|すうじつ}{前|まえ}: a few days ago
- {数日|すうじつ}{後|ご}: in a few days
- {数日|すうじつ}{間|かん}: for several days
- {数日|すうじつ}にわたって: over a span of several days

RELATED TERMS WITH {数|すう}:
- {数時間|すうじかん}: several hours
- {数週間|すうしゅうかん}: several weeks
- 数か{月|げつ}: several months
- {数年|すうねん}: several years
- {数人|すうにん}: several people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何日|なんにち}か: some days, a few days — more casual
- {二三日|にさんにち}: two or three days — more specific
- {数日|すうじつ}{間|かん}: for a period of several days — adds the time-span marker
